Hi Michael,

We are moving our remit for Redwood invoices to a centralized AP team next quarter and want to confirm the billing flow for the upcoming renewal/expansion. Two quick items:  

1) Purchase Order: attached is our PO (FjordWorks_PO_12345.pdf). Can you confirm Redwood will accept this as the commitment reference for the July renewal charge?

Hi Sofia — thanks for the PO and the heads-up. Quick answers below:  

- Commitment reference: yes, we can tie the renewal/expansion to PO #12345 and the contract ID DW-4721 — I'll include both on the invoice.
- Net terms: Net 60 is a non-standard request for renewals on our hosted billing plan. Our standard is Net 30, but we do support Net 60 on a case-by-case basis with finance approval.

I'll loop in our finance lead to confirm and to get the proforma invoice and exact remit instructions over to procurement. Also, can you confirm the legal entity name and tax ID you want on the invoice (if different from the PO)? That helps avoid reissues.

I'll follow up early next week after I sync with finance.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

I've attached the proforma invoice (Redwood_Invoice_Proforma_0726.pdf) which shows the DW-4721 reference and line-item for the 40% capacity increase beginning Aug 1. Once we have the signed amendment, we'll issue the official invoice with Net 60 terms.
